details: Factor value/quantile/bucket fields are distinct from forward-return fields.
Every evaluation row carries a current-or-past no-lookahead status.
Forward returns and benchmark-excess returns are consumed only to compute post-hoc IC/RankIC/spread metrics, never as factor or regime inputs.
Regime-conditional summary exposes derived metrics only, no raw forward-return columns.
Regime labels are consumed as committed conditioning context and are not re-derived from factor performance.
